shortDescription: Flex NASDAQ:FLEX said Tuesday it named its planned cloud and power infrastructure spinoff Axiom Solutions International and filed a preliminary Form 10 registration statement with the SEC.The new entity is expected to trade on the Nasdaq under the AXM ticker symbol upon completion of the separation…

children: its planned cloud and power infrastructure spinoff Axiom Solutions International and filed a preliminary Form 10 registration statement with the SEC.
The new entity is expected to trade on the Nasdaq under the AXM ticker symbol upon completion of the separation, which is expected by Q1 2027.

CEO Revathi Advaithi, who is expected to become Axiom's top executive.
